cohort: The study included 104 patients with gestational hypertension who underwent cesarean section.
finding: Dexmedetomidine administration to patients with gestational hypertension after cesarean section enhanced sedative effects, accelerated recovery, protected the myocardium, reduced stress response, and improved coagulation function.
mod_finding: Dexmedetomidine used in patients with gestational hypertension after cesarean section was found to enhance sedation, accelerate recovery, protect the myocardium, reduce stress response, and improve coagulation function.
